notes: No Genre: 'a base plate with trees and Hills' names no game type at all — it is terrain, which is exactly the place-not-a-genre case rather than a failure to classify. No shape row applies, so the axes carry it: an ordinary single exterior surface, dressed, walked on, with verticality at tiered because rounded green hills are real elevation that never overhangs, which is the only thing here that costs anything. With no user to ask I took the preset as none rather than Explorable Place, because the author asked to keep it 'small and plainly playable' and never asked to be shown anything — adding a focal landmark and scenic vantage points would be padding a seven-word terrain request. The trees are scene content with no option ID of their own; terrain-relief carries the hills and should be bent to 'simple Roblox-friendly trees and rounded green hills at default baseplate scale'.
